scope: One corner sprite proposal only. Do not generate remaining sprites or update scenes until the user validates this proposal.
generation_prompt:
Create ONE complete native-alpha game sprite: an L-shaped dark stone dungeon wall corner.
Image 1 is an EXACT, color-coded geometry template. Image 2 is the user's original dungeon, the ONLY reference for painting style, stone colors and gloomy atmosphere.
Keep image 1's 1024x1024 canvas, silhouette, planes and corner geometry. Paint the template, not a different 3D view.
CRITICAL PLANE DEFINITIONS: ALL GREEN pixels define one continuous horizontal TOP surface, including the ENTIRE LONG VERTICAL LEG on screen. That entire green L must become top-facing cap stones in the SAME blue-gray value range. Do NOT paint a frontal brick facade on any of that green area. Both RUST-RED areas are vertical front facades and should contain two staggered darker masonry courses. BLUE areas are narrow dark RIGHT-SIDE wall faces. Remove ALL guide colors in the final painting.
Perspective contract dungeon-parallel-v1: parallel oblique 2.5D; ground X screen-right and ground Y screen-down. Every corresponding top-to-foot point shifts +32 right and +192 down in this template (uniformly scaled from +16,+96). No camera rotation, no mirrored side, no isometric slanted ground axes. Keep the entire L top planar. The large red front plane meets the narrow blue inside side plane continuously at the inner corner.
Style: exactly the original's hand-painted cartoon slate-blue dungeon masonry, dark navy crevices, broad restrained facets, softly worn thick stone edges and charcoal outline. Moody and subdued. The complete top L uses the same dark slate-blue stone color as unlit wall tops in the reference. Front/side faces are darker shades of that same stone. Muted highlights from upper-left; no white/silver rim, glossy stone or pale blue.
Divide the upper L naturally into roughly 3 cap stones along each leg with opaque dark mortar joints. Use small chips and quiet color differences, not large repetitive cracks. No added cap-height division on the vertical leg. On the wide FRONT facade only, add one small dim amethyst-violet glowing fissure, like the original reference, with very localized glow on surrounding stone. Keep the rest dark and calm.
This is a connected solid masonry volume, with no floating bricks, transparent seams, thin curtain, black patch filling missing stone, extra steps or isolated pillars.
Genuine transparent RGBA outside the exact silhouette. No floor, props, labels, background, cast shadow, vignette or baked checkerboard.
material_edit_prompt:
Precise material edit of INPUT 1, the L-shaped wall prototype. INPUT 2 is the user's original dungeon palette reference.
Preserve EXACTLY the entire silhouette, sizes, camera, placement, stone divisions, outline thickness, all geometry and native transparent alpha from input 1. Change only the painting, not any plane or projection.
Make the ENTIRE upper L much darker and quieter, matching the gloomy UNLIT stone caps in input 2. The current upper stones are pale/icy blue and busy with diagonal patchwork. Replace that with dark desaturated slate-blue, representative top midtone RGB(49,61,87), broad calm painted areas, very few gentle facets. All horizontal and vertical TOP stones must use this SAME palette. Restrained bevel highlights around RGB(75,90,119), no white/silver rim. Front masonry representative RGB(28,36,55), narrow right-side faces darker still. Retain enough contrast to read the depth. Remove every loose pebble sitting on top; replace it with smooth matching stone. Keep small edge wear, simplify the excessive diagonal surface pattern and cracks. Do not add grain or noise.
Keep the single small violet fissure on the front facade, with localized purple illumination as in the original. It is the one luminous accent. No global purple wash.
Perspective contract dungeon-parallel-v1 remains unchanged: ground X right/Y down, all corresponding top-to-foot points down and slightly right, NEVER mirrored. The whole upper L remains a TOP plane.
Output the same composition on genuine transparent background. No added floor, props, lettering, shadow or background.
rejection_reason: Vertical top planes and corner top planes were painted as front facades. Rejected by the user; never integrate or use as reference.
